'''''A Rebel Painting''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] depicting the exploits of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The painting depicted two [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] flying away from a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with the [[Alliance Starbird]] in the center.

{{Reb-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The painting was given out, alongside ''[[Portrait of the Emperor]]'', to players who attended the 2006 SWG Fanfest, with players having to choose between the two. Since Star Wars Galaxy's 10th Game Update, it alongside ''Portrait of the Emperor'' have been declared to be shared no trade items.
